FN-NRR7HTJ-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 352
Committee: Agriculture and Forestry Sponsor: Representative Danny Crawford
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 03/03/2025
House Bill 352 as introduced could increase receipts to the Agricultural Fund by an estimated
$7,000 annually, if cotton producers vote to increase the levy assessed on cotton sales in the
state from $1 per bale, under current law, to $1.30 per bale, as provided by this bill.
Page 1

FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 352
Committee: Agriculture, Conservation, and Forestry Sponsor: Representative Danny Crawford
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 04/04/2025
House Bill 352 as passed the House of Representatives could increase receipts to the
Agricultural Fund by an estimated $7,000 annually, if cotton producers vote to increase the levy
assessed on cotton sales in the state from $1 per bale, under current law, to $1.30 per bale, as
provided by this bill.
